name: tictoon-comics
description: Publish comic images created or attached in ChatGPT to your TicToon channels.

interface.longDescription: TicToon lets you publish comics made in ChatGPT to the TicToon channels you have joined. List your channels, upload images you created or attached in ChatGPT (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 per post), and publish them as a new comic thread with a caption. Every action runs with the permissions you granted when connecting, and you can only post in channels you already joined. You can disconnect at any time from Connected apps on tictoon.app.

positive.description: List the TicToon channels the user can post to
positive.prompt: Show me the TicToon channels I have joined.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the joined channels, including the channel named 테스트, with their names and member counts. Nothing is posted.

positive.prompt: Check the TicToon channel 테스트 and tell me whether I can post there.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the channel 테스트 and reports its name, status and that the user has joined it. Nothing is posted.

positive.description: Publish an attached image as a new comic thread
positive.prompt: Post the attached image to my TicToon channel 테스트 with the caption "Review test comic".
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the attached image, publishes one comic thread with the caption "Review test comic" in 테스트, and returns a link to the post on tictoon.app.

positive.description: Publish a comic image generated in ChatGPT
positive.prompt: Draw a simple one-panel comic of a cat heading home from work, then publish it to my TicToon channel 테스트 with the caption "Cat commute".
positive.expected_behavior: After ChatGPT generates the image, uploads it and publishes a comic thread captioned "Cat commute" in 테스트, then returns the post link.

positive.prompt: Show me the TicToon post you just published, with its caption and images.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the published thread's caption, its images in order and the link to the post. Nothing new is posted.

negative.description: General comic recommendations are not a TicToon publishing task
negative.prompt: Recommend some popular webtoons I should read this weekend.

negative.description: Drawing advice does not need TicToon
negative.prompt: How do I lay out panels for a four-panel comic strip?

negative.description: Managing channels is not supported by the TicToon app
negative.prompt: Delete my TicToon channel and remove all its members.
